description: This file manages task status logic, including status categorization, text formatting, and snapshot building for tasks in a task management system.

methods.name: isActiveTask
methods.description: Checks if a task's status is active ('queued' or 'running').

methods.name: isFailureTask
methods.description: Checks if a task's status indicates failure ('failed', 'timed_out', 'lost').

methods.name: resolveTaskReferenceAt
methods.description: Determines the reference time for a task based on its status.

methods.name: isExpiredTask
methods.description: Checks if a task has expired based on its cleanup time.

methods.name: isRecentTerminalTask
methods.description: Checks if a task is a recent terminal task within a defined window.

methods.name: truncateTaskStatusText
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum character length, appending an ellipsis if needed.

methods.name: sanitizeTaskStatusValue
methods.description: Sanitizes various types of task status values, including strings, arrays, and objects.

methods.name: sanitizeTaskStatusText
methods.description: Sanitizes and optionally truncates task status text.

methods.name: formatTaskStatusTitleText
methods.description: Formats task status title text with a fallback.

methods.name: formatTaskStatusTitle
methods.description: Formats the title for a task status.

methods.name: formatTaskStatusDetail
methods.description: Formats detailed status information for a task, including error and terminal summaries.

methods.name: buildTaskStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Builds a snapshot of current task statuses, categorizing active, recent terminal, and visible tasks.
